caption: The drawing depicts a detailed line illustration of a corner cupboard in an Early American style. The main image on the left shows the front elevation view, featuring a tall, arched upper section with decorative fan or shell carving at the top center, flanked by triangular panels with floral motifs at the top corners. Below the arch are two open shelves framed by molding, and underneath is a base section housing two rectangular cabinet doors, each hinged on the outer side and decorated with an inner rectangular border, with one door displaying a keyhole. At the bottom of the cupboard are bracket-shaped decorative cutouts at the base corners. To the right of the frontal view, a vertical cross-section reveals the cupboard's proportions and internal structure, marked with the overall height of 7 feet 3½ inches. The side also features a contour outline labeled "contour of shelves," indicating the shelving profile. In the upper right corner of the drawing, handwritten text reads: "CORNER CUPBOARD EARLY AMERICAN SIENNA TONE (MEDIUM DEPTH) APPARENTLY DARK OAK STAIN SCALE: 1½'' = 1' 0''. The composition uses black ink linework on a beige or yellowed paper background and does not contain any color fill or shading.
title: Corner Cupboard
